sources.title: thox-micro-125m API & Inference Endpoint | FriendliAI
sources.snippet: Unlike THOX's 327M (whose FFN dim of 3413 forces K-quants only), this model's FFN dim of 2048 divides evenly, so the ARM-friendly legacy Q4_0 and Q8_0 formats both apply. Note: some files named thox-micro-125m.*.gguf with uppercase quant suffixes also exist in this repository from an earlier upload.
